segments.text: What can you do?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.

segments.text: – I can lift this box, but I can't lift that heavy chair.

segments.text: What can Pamela do?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.

segments.text: – Well, she can type, but she can't type this letter for the boss. She can't read his handwriting!
